answer: An agent marketplace requires every trading identity to lock 100 credits in escrow for 30 days before submitting bids; agents named comet, raven, and oasis face the same rule. A new public key cannot reuse another key’s deposit, and closing an account does not release funds early. Each extra fake identity therefore requires another 100 credits of locked capital. At a 12% annual borrowing rate, that adds about 0.99 credits in financing cost per identity per month, even if no fraud is detected.
